introHtml: Gray bistro mugs offer a neutral, sophisticated look that pairs well with any logo or design. Whether you're outfitting a breakroom or creating a giveaway for a coffee-themed event, these ceramic mugs provide a sturdy, comfortable handle and a classic 12 oz capacity. Choose from imprint methods like full-color wrap or single-color screen printing to match your brand's style.
